_readme: Supplier page details for Gym Business News, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). Where the site gave no usable logo, the logo is from the company's Wikimedia Commons file. dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.

ABC Fitness.line: Software for running memberships, sales, marketing and payments at fitness businesses.

Aescape.line: Robotic massage system that maps the body and adapts each session.

Centr.line: Connected strength equipment, coaching and training plans.

ClubWise.line: Club management software for memberships, payments, bookings and reporting.

CoverMe.line: Workforce platform that helps gyms find instructor cover and manage staff.

Daxko.line: Fitness management software for nonprofits, studios and clubs.

FITBENCH.line: Space-saving functional training equipment for gyms.

Future Fit.line: Personal trainer, nutrition and Pilates courses.

Glofox.line: Fitness management software for studios and gyms, part of ABC Fitness.

Hussle.line: Gym pass and flexible membership network covering gyms across the UK.

HYROX.line: Fitness racing series that gyms can join as training partners.

Legend.line: Leisure management software for local authorities, leisure trusts and universities.

Mariana Tek.line: Business management software for boutique fitness studios.

Matrix Fitness.line: Commercial fitness and home gym equipment.

Oura.line: Smart ring that tracks sleep, fitness and stress.

Output Sports.line: Athlete testing, training and tracking system for coaches.

Peloton.line: Exercise equipment and personalised workout programmes.

Playlist.line: Group behind Mindbody, Booker, ClassPass and EGYM.

Pulse Fitness.line: UK company that designs and builds fitness equipment.

RockSalt Pilates.line: Pilates studio brand growing through franchising.

RunX.line: Treadmill 5k running competition hosted by official gym centres.

Simply Business.line: Insurance for small businesses and landlords.

Strong Pilates.line: Pilates, strength and cardio studio brand with UK franchise studios.

Sweatpals.line: Social app for finding wellness clubs, workout classes and events.

The PT Development Center.line: Business education for personal trainers and fitness professionals.

Torque Fitness.line: Strength and functional training equipment for home and commercial gyms.

Training Mate.line: HIIT and group fitness studio brand seeking franchisees.

Trainerize.line: Personal training software for delivering programmes and tracking clients, part of ABC Fitness.

VersaClimber.line: US maker of the VersaClimber vertical climbing cardio machine.

Wattbike.line: Smart indoor bikes and cycling trainers.

Xplor.line: Software and payments group whose fitness brands include Resamania, Mariana Tek and Legend.

Xponential Fitness.line: Franchise group of boutique fitness brands including Club Pilates and Pure Barre.

Zen Planner.line: Gym management software for operations, member engagement and billing.
